evidence: The Ge and Te precursors were heated to 65 and 35 °C, respectively, where 0.079 and 1 Torr vapor pressures were achieved. The precursors were carried to the ALD chamber by the Ar carrier gas at a flow rate of 50 standard cubic centimeters per min (sccm). For the purge process, 200 sccm Ar gas was used.
